text_block_list.text:
The second leg of the Classic Triple 
Crown, the Japanese Derby. Seiun Sky 
suffered defeat against Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The venue erupted in cheers for Special 
Week's victory. Her strength had been 
proven, earning her even greater acclaim.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky is deeply impressed by her 
strength. The contest moves onward to the 
final leg of the Classic Triple Crown: the 
Kikuka Sho—
